newsitem.title: CANADA: Singapore economic conference set for June 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore economic conference set for June 26.

text.p: The third International Conference on forecasting the Singapore economy and annual review of central banking policies in the Asia Pacific Basin is due to be held on June 26-28 at the Mandarin Hotel in Singapore, the conference organisers said.

The conference will present the sectoral forecasts of the Singapore economy for 1997-98 from the Econometric Modelling Unit at the Nanyang Technological University and later central bankers from the Asia Pacific region will be addressing the conference.
There will also be panel discussion on major themes and trends significant to the Asia Pacific region.

Speakers include Shih Jie Dong, Deputy Governor of The Central Bank of China and Chad Leechor, Head of the Economic Department of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. Speakers from the economic departments of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Bank of Japan, the Reserve Bank of Australia and Bank Negara Malaysia will also attend.
